title: Hoshino Ichika — An Umbrella Waiting For Clear Skies〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: An Umbrella Waiting For Clear Skies（2★）

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is a rare sight. Saki never falls asleep during class...)

rows.Speaker: Student's Voice
rows.Line: It's such a pain going back and forth between our classroom and the AV room. Can't we just do everything in one place...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, it's class A. Maybe they're switching classrooms...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Was she checking up on Saki...? But why...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Phew. I'm glad our meeting ended so soon.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All that's left is to meet with everyone in SEKAI and... Hm?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami? What are you doing standing around here?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Shiho? Is something wrong?
You seem concerned...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'll be going now too!
Good luck at work, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho is probably worried about Saki. And since Saki's also working so hard lately, Shiho must be concerned about her health...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And then Honami was worried about Shiho...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She also followed after her yesterday but I wonder if they were able to talk.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I'm worried about Saki, so I should probably tell her to take care. I hope she'll feel a little better just from hearing that...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh... But I'm in charge of making the school's newspaper this week and the next, which will take up most of my lunch time.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Since we might not be able to talk much during our breaks, it'll probably need to wait until after school.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? What brings you to my class, Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I, uh... It's just...!
I came to see you...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe. You're not fooling me that easily.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I did come to this class by accident, but there is something I need to talk to you about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So if I could borrow you for a second...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This isn't how I was expecting to talk to her, but I have to get this off my chest...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I guess it was bothering her too...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (What should I do...? I want to talk to her and find a way to put her at ease...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I'm not anything I say will work right now...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure that I'll be able to have lunch today with Saki because of student council business!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So I was wondering if you could invite her instead and have lunch together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Is that what you wanted to ask...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But Saki so many other friends that she could have lunch with...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I think she'd be ecstatic if you invited her!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So if it's alright with you, Shiho, would you mind?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine, if I feel like it then...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I really just let myself go there...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I'm sure she'll invite her to lunch now.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (As long as she actually sits down and finds the time to talk to Saki, everything will turn out okay.)
